ISS Secret Technician_Desc:
We at FASA are in trouble—a critical device on the International Space Station has failed and needs urgent repairs!

A few months ago, you requested funds to develop a cargo capsule, which we declined. Today, we’re reversing that decision and funding your capsule. The technician must reach the ISS as soon as possible. However, this mission needs to stay a secret, as there isn’t enough time to properly human-certify the vehicle!
ISS Secret Technician Payload_Desc: A courageous technician flying in a capsule without life support systems to save the ISS!
